Definition: Bered, the name of a place south of Palestine, also of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Bered means "hail." The name is shared by several bearers: A son or descendant of Ephraim; A place in the south of Palestine, near Kadesh, near the well Lahairoi. It turns up in Genesis 16:14 and 1 Chronicles 7:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bered matters because the land itself is part of the promise.
